experiment: comparison of current shoulder+AP-10K-hip and neck+tail-root body references

A.center: midpoint of the left/right shoulder midpoint and left/right AP-10K hip midpoint
A.length: Euclidean distance between shoulder midpoint and AP-10K hip midpoint

B.center: midpoint between neck and root of tail
B.length: Euclidean distance between neck and root of tail

measurementRules.referencePasses: Dog detection succeeded and all required method landmarks have raw scores >= 0.80.
measurementRules.rightBackPawPosition: Requires the method reference and right_back_paw raw score >= 0.80; normalized x/y are (paw-center)/reference length.
measurementRules.consecutiveLengthPairs: Both adjacent frames must have references passing the method's threshold.
measurementRules.jumpCheck: Consecutive normalized right-back-paw positions, both available, flagged above 0.35 reference lengths per frame.

ap10kDefinitionNote: AP-10K README lists left/right hip as paired animal-side keypoints and notes that for digitigrade animals such as dogs, 'hip' is placed at the knee-level landmark; it is not necessarily the anatomical pelvis.
